examined_formations.title: VIBE_CODED_APP_PRELAUNCH_SECURITY_AND_PRODUCTION_READINESS_AUDIT
examined_formations.chinese_title: Vibe Coding 应用上线前安全与生产就绪审计
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current buyers explicitly pay $50-$100/hour or fixed fees to review AI-built Supabase/Next.js/Stripe apps before launch, but live jobs attract 20-50+ or 50+ proposals and purpose-built scanners plus mature SAST/pentest/autofix platforms already own the automatable control surface.

examined_formations.title: VOICE_AI_ACCEPTANCE_TESTING_AND_REGRESSION_QA
examined_formations.chinese_title: Voice AI 上线验收与回归 QA
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current voice-agent deployments pay for explicit acceptance testing and regression work, but Coval, Hamming and Cekura already provide simulation, production evals, human QA, regression, compliance and vendor comparison as a mature category.

examined_formations.title: TIKTOK_SHOP_SUSPENSION_AND_PRODUCT_REMOVAL_APPEAL
examined_formations.chinese_title: TikTok Shop 封店与商品移除申诉
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current $100 product-removal appeal job has fewer than five proposals and other suspension/onboarding jobs show real paid friction, but final adjudication and escalation remain TikTok-owned while evidence interpretation and appeal strategy are case-specific human work.

examined_formations.title: EUDR_TRACES_NT_ERP_CRM_INTEGRATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: EUDR TRACES-NT 与 ERP/CRM 集成
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current $200 Zoho/EUDR TRACES-NT SOAP integration job proves paid API friction and the EU publishes a machine-callable operator API, but mappings, customer data models, credentials, GeoJSON, HS codes and compliance conclusions remain customer-specific integration work rather than a reusable autonomous operator asset.

examined_formations.title: EU_PRODUCT_PRELAUNCH_COMPLIANCE_GAP_REVIEW
examined_formations.chinese_title: 欧盟产品上市前合规缺口审查
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current €/$300-class PPE compliance review has fewer than five proposals and a hire, showing real scarce specialist demand, but standards interpretation, certificate validity, claims substantiation and legal labeling obligations require domain-expert judgment and carry material liability.

examined_formations.title: LLM_RAG_AGENT_EVALUATION_AND_OBSERVABILITY_SETUP
examined_formations.chinese_title: LLM/RAG/Agent 评测与可观测性搭建
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current buyers hire for evaluation architecture and adversarial test corpora, but LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, Arize/Phoenix and similar platforms already provide tracing, evals, CI/CD, human review and production monitoring; custom setup remains engineering services.
